cecca.p: [Cita+ṇe+tvā] (kri,vi) Google Translate Stimulate (with effort). cecca စစ် စ (တိ) [စေ တ + ယ. မောဂ်၊ Four. Yes. 25. See, the king who rules over all the pagodas in Saetana. King of the Pagoda.
